applies_to: AAON units built with Stratus controls (Stratus Unit Manager, software 1.3.3).
summary: Stratus is AAON's newest unit control platform; the Stratus Unit Manager connects to a BACnet MS/TP trunk or to Ethernet for BACnet IP. Its BACnet map is compact: 57 analog values (temperatures, humidity, airflow, fan and refrigeration modulation, active setpoints, plus writable setpoints at AV 10003-10009), 43 binary values for status, sensor and safety alarms, 4 multistate values for application, mode and occupancy, an occupancy schedule object and a schedule-driven binary input.
notes: Access is from the guide's R/W column. All analog values below 10000 are read-only; AV 10003-10009 and MV 10001 are writable. BV 10002 is listed as RO although it is described as a command.
Section 2 is titled Binary Values but its table caption says Binary Inputs; the objects are listed here as BV.
Multistate state lists are printed without numbers; they are given in the printed order.
AV 30-33 and AV 36-39 are reserved for future use (the unit currently supports two circuits and two condenser fan banks). AV 3 Supply Air Dewpoint is printed with % units.
AV 10004-10009 are shared with the Unit Manager setpoints; a change in either place shows in both.
Source: Stratus BACnet Points Guide Rev. A (software 1.3.3), pages 1-10.

integration.summary: Connect the Unit Manager to MS/TP or Ethernet (BACnet IP) and set the baud rate, MAC address and a unique device ID (and BBMD for IP) in Unit Settings. The BAS forces occupancy with MV 10001 or writes the Occupied Schedule, adjusts the occupied and unoccupied setpoints at AV 10004-10007 and can override the supply air setpoint with AV 10003. Read the mode, occupancy and alarm BVs.

minimum_points.name: Force Occupancy
minimum_points.why: Occupancy: auto, force occupied or unoccupied

minimum_points.name: Supply Air Setpoint Override
minimum_points.why: Supply air setpoint override; rewrite every 5 min

integration.enable: MV 10001 Force Occupancy (Auto, Force Occupied, Force Unoccupied) or the Occupied Schedule object (Schedule 2, which writes BI 1) set occupancy. BV 10002 can disable economizer operation (inverted logic).
integration.heartbeat: AV 10003 Supply Air Setpoint Override must be written at least every five minutes or it is treated as invalid and the normal control mode takes over the supply air setpoint.
setup: MS/TP: set baud rate, MAC address (masters 0-127) and a unique device ID in Unit Settings; all devices on the trunk need the same baud.
BACnet IP over the Ethernet port: set the BBMD/network and device ID.
gotchas: Writing a low value to AV 10003 disables the override; the footnote says below 40°F and the notes column says below 32°F.
Setpoints at AV 10004-10009 are shared with the Unit Manager screen, so local changes overwrite BAS values and vice versa.
